Title: Document 7
Content: Source: Cuban mother, interviewed by a United States journalist in Cuba, `text(1980)`.

Now, in Cuba, there is a Family Code* that guarantees the equal rights of women in their homes. Everything is not different in a `text(single day)`, but it has made a difference for us all. The day-care centers also help us develop our careers. My daughters are students in the public schools. The little `text(one)` goes to a day school. My older daughter is a student at a `text(five-day-a-week)` boarding school in the countryside.
References: Adopted by the Cuban government in `text(1975)`
